Hello, I’m Ronaldo · Based in Cochabamba, Bolivia

Ronaldo Franco Jaldin

Machine Learning Research Engineer

I work on large language models, retrieval, GFlowNets, and computer vision. My experience combines research in software engineering with applied systems for video analysis, inventory access, and face attendance.

I studied Applied Mathematics and Informatics at HSE University, competed at the ICPC World Finals, and teach machine learning and competitive programming.
